title: Merge 'pop' is an instant width change, not an animated tween (AC wording says 'animation')
evidence: AC: "Drawing a second parallel pipe → the two bundle, with a merge \"pop\" animation." Actual code: `width := (tier_pipe_width(v, tier) + f32(count-1)*BUNDLE_EXTRA_WIDTH) * v.scale` — a pure function of member `count` with no time component. grep for `tween|ease|pulse|GetTime|GetFrameTime` across app/render returns no animation infra (only the tick `dt` clamp in app/main.odin:98). Golden contract treats it as a frame: lens AC list says "Golden: T2 (the merge-pop frame)" and demos/bundle.dem `capture at 2550ms` (50ms after the `at 2500ms draw` merge).
detail: AC says "a merge 'pop' animation"; the impl is an instant static width change (width = f(count), no tween/time). Golden treats the merge-pop as one frame; no animation infra exists in slices 1–2 (juice is slice 7).
recommended_fix: None for 2.1 — the instant fatter-pooled-link read satisfies the slice-2 'pop' and is golden-verified (harness bundle PASS). An animated pop tween is slice-7 (Story 7.1) visual-juice territory.
